notes: Settings opens About onto Version & Info, Check for Update, Download latest version, Give Feedback, What's New, Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, and Open-source notices. There is no second About row.
QR codes for My List, feedback, and support include the FEFC logo in the picture, and they still scan.
The line under a QR code is a short link you can select. The code itself still encodes the full address.
Selecting a file, folder, or action plays the click again, and Back and Home play the back cue. Sound off stays silent.
Pausing, resuming, fast-forward, and rewind play a short quiet cue over the video.
The pause bar, its label, and the time sit at the bottom of the screen, inside the TV safe area.
Opening a file or its folder plays a random clip from that title. Westworld files play a Westworld clip. The details page retries if the clip address is not ready on the first look.
If an update fails, the popup and Settings list a manual download for Fire TV and Android (FEFC.apk only), Samsung TV (the widget and the guide), and the web app.

Genres hides the folder list behind the board. The four wall tiles stay visible. Genre names sit on a dark band. Drama uses the Godfather still of Brando and Pacino. Crime uses a text-free still from the Heat (1995) downtown shootout.
The back tile says Back and shows one folder icon. Search shows the Grok, Discord, and Muse marks with no captions.
Genre folders list only files and collections in the Drive root, once each, using IMDb genres when the title has an IMDb id. Patton is Biography, Drama, and War.
Folder grids line up with the Back tile. Every folder has Support Us and an Add to My List star.
Search results use the same poster grid as other folders. Wrapped titles stay inside the row, with space above the menu.
Search, genres, and the other combined lists show each file once. The FEFC-hosted original is kept; a shortcut is shown only when that original is not in the list.
The details page Download button stays labeled. Synopsis, editor, ratings, and file size load with the listing, and a file with no editorial notes still shows its size and folder.
Fan edits of a TV series use the series poster. Westworld Series now uses the HBO series art instead of the 1973 film.
After an install, coming back to the app reads the package on disk. A process left running from the previous build restarts, and the button shows Up to date instead of Update available.
Folder, genre, person, My List and search screens show their tiles again. The grid no longer hides when the TV does not report view 500 or 501.
While the news ticker is still loading, the bar says Loading Fan Edit Fan Club Ticker, centered and still. It scrolls once the items arrive.
Sound off takes effect immediately. The button and the ambience no longer wait for the settings file.
Search opens on the first press. Enter or Done on the keyboard opens the results. Back from the results returns to Search.
Genre folders list the main collection, with Sort, Shuffle Play and Support Us. Back from a genre returns to Genres.
The Genres page has no wordmark or tagline. The title sits between two mosaic tiles on each side.
An app update shows a centered progress popup: percent and megabytes, Verifying, Ready to install, and Failed with Retry.
Actors and Directors opens from the saved page instead of rebuilding the whole catalogue.
The SOUND button uses the same outlined bar as the other menu buttons. The Grok mark is the flat iOS icon.
Genres opens on the Home mosaic instead of the stock Videos menu. The top-centre cell reads GENRES. The other mosaic cells keep playing.
Each genre tile shows its artwork again. Opening a genre lists that genre's main-collection folders and files, one page at a time. To Be Catalogued stays out.
Fire TV Back is PreviousMenu again on every screen.
SOUND ON and SETTINGS fit on the menu bar.
Support Us shows the whole Optimus frame, down to the lowest row of the clip, above the menu.
The focus-move sound and the Back sound are a little quieter. The intro, the wall and the clips are unchanged.
Back returns to the previous screen again on Home, Search, folders, My List, New Arrivals, details, Support Us and Settings.
Down from the last row of a folder reaches HOME, SEARCH, SOUND and SETTINGS. Up from that bar returns to the list.
Search is one bar. Optimus keeps looping until you type, then starts again if you leave the bar empty.
Folders that mix subfolders and videos no longer leave a blank band between the two.
The home mosaic no longer plays video behind the title or behind the bottom menu. The corner and side tiles stay.
New Arrivals opens the newest files instead of trying to list the whole catalogue.
Poster titles are larger, centered, and wrap. The focused title scrolls the full name.
Videos without a poster use a sibling poster or the file's own thumbnail.
The feedback code is the Google Form address. Every code has the FEFC mark in the center and still scans.
The PayPal code opens the PayPal profile page directly. It no longer uses the paypal.biz redirect.
The long-press menu no longer offers Add to favourites. Add to My List is the list action.
Home mosaic is a full perimeter again: five video cells across the top, five across the bottom, and five down each side, including all four corners, the same size as the menu tiles.
Tapping outside the menu tiles no longer opens or restarts the background.
SKIP sits in the bottom-right corner, inside the TV safe area, and appears about 3 seconds into the intro. One Select press skips to Home. The intro video is unchanged.

Home background video keeps playing with its ambience. On other screens the picture hides and the same ambience continues. A film or the intro takes the player; ambience returns when you are browsing again. Sound Off stays silent.
Opening a collection, folder, or video plays its existing clip without stopping the ambience. Sound Off stays silent.
Search, Settings, Home, and the update label show the full words.
The news ticker keeps scrolling on every browsing screen, including My List, and no longer shows raw web addresses.
Actors and Directors show the original folder names, in alphabetical order, not expanded full names.
Collection folder tiles drop the count badge and centre the full folder name. Home tile counts stay.
Video files stay portrait posters. Folders, collections, and action buttons stay landscape.
My List has a star by the heading. Link My List, Recently Opened, and Downloads are readable landscape tiles. Sort offers Date added, A-Z, and Z-A. Shuffle Play queues starred videos only.
Support Us uses landscape Patreon, PayPal, and Venmo cards with Optimus. Each card opens a square code for the same link.
Link My List, feedback, and payment codes are square, with a white quiet zone, and are not stretched.

Search shows a silent frame loop of Optimus watching a film and eating popcorn. It stops when the search field is used. The home ambience keeps playing. The still picture remains if the frames are missing.
Home mosaic is the earlier layout again: five tiles down each side and three along the bottom, shown full-frame around the 3x3 menu.
SKIP is a Home-style button in the safe area and appears when the intro starts playing. The intro video is unchanged.
Bottom menu labels fit, including Checking for updates, Update available, Up to date and Unable to check.
The news ticker scrolls smoothly and does not jump back to the start when the feed refreshes. A failed fetch keeps the previous line.
Folder names are larger. Poster titles are unchanged.
Actors and Directors show the full name, in last-name order, with no count on the tile.
Search takes a title on the Optimus card. An empty search or a catalogue problem shows a message.
Support Us logos fit inside their tiles and Optimus stays still.
Cast names are one color. The focused row uses a border, not a different text color.
Back plays the navigation sound while ambience is playing. Sound Off stays silent.
The update tile says Checking for updates, with a progress bar, until the check finishes. A failed check says Unable to check, not Up to date.
About and the update control are only on Home.
The download progress shows percent and size. A short sound plays when a download starts, when the file checks out, and when it fails, unless Sound is off.
Installing does not mark the new build as installed before Android asks you to confirm. Fully close FEFC and open it again after Android finishes.

News ticker now keeps scrolling on every page — it used to freeze once you opened a folder. It also pulls the newest files from the live database, so it updates with the 3-hour resync instead of only once a day.

Support Us page rebuilt: clean PayPal, Patreon and Venmo logos (no more white-circle discs), and Fan Edit Optimus on the left holding out his hat for change, bobbing away while he pleads. The three QR codes and links still open in your browser when tapped.
Tapping outside the home tiles no longer makes the screen stutter and reset — taps on the corner videos are ignored now.
Home mosaic video re-rendered: 3 equal tiles per side, lined up with the 3 home rows, plus one equal tile in each of the 4 corners.
Stallone set is complete — the Rocky IV 'If I can change' speech joins the rotation, 7 clips now.
Schwarzenegger set: Predator theme, 'See you at the party, Richter', 'Two weeks' and more join the rotation.
Back sound now plays when you tap the ".." back-folder row, not just the Android back gesture.
Directors and folders no longer show a (0) count when their videos live in subfolders — the count is the real total.
Sound clips now match the file itself, not just its folder — an Armageddon file in the root plays Armageddon clips, a Die Hard file plays Die Hard quotes.

New sound sets: Costner (11 — Yellowstone, Dunbar and Robin Hood themes plus quotes), Stallone (Rocky theme plus 4 new quotes), Armageddon (12, including the full 93-second detonation sequence), Ridley Scott (Gladiator theme and quotes, Blade Runner Tears in Rain, Alien), Cameron (13), Nolan (Dark Knight theme and quotes, Inception, Interstellar, Oppenheimer).
Avengers Assemble rotation no longer cuts off before "Assemble" — the short 2.6-second cut is gone.
Austin Powers Mustafa clip plays in full — the whole burn and "you shot me" sequence, 71 seconds.
Willis pounce sound effect removed — it was a bass thump, not a Willis quote.
Download button on the details page no longer says the word twice.
Open in VLC and Open in Drive go straight to the app — no app-chooser menu first.
Video titles on the details page show in full over three lines, with no scrolling.
Downloads folder: videos stay portrait while the Sort and storage rows stay landscape — the view no longer flips everything to portrait.
Poster tile file names use a smaller label so long names fit instead of clipping.
Schwarzenegger folder now rotates eight clips — I'll Be Back, Hasta La Vista Baby, Come With Me, Terminator theme, Get to the Chopper, Total Recall theme, Consider It a Divorce and Kuato.
Support Us, Shuffle Play and Sort tiles have bigger text; the Support Us tile is just the words, no brand icons.
Home tagline sits lower, centred in the gap between the wordmark and the tile grid.
About: Give feedback is now the first option, with a short link (is.gd/UVko0K) — tap the QR code or the link to open the form in your browser.
Genre folders: counts no longer include duplicate shortcuts, and the names stay readable over bright artwork.
Skip Intro button moved to the bottom-right corner, low down and out of the way.
Bottom menu buttons: text no longer cut off — the bar font now lives in one place (the old per-button override was not reliably winning).

Home background video now plays in the bottom-left and bottom-right corners, clear of the bottom menu bar; every screen has a black background. The ambience audio keeps playing smoothly on all screens — the video is hidden off-Home, not stopped.
News ticker strips bare-domain links too (discord.gg, x.com, faneditfanclub.com, bit.ly and the like), not just http:// and www. links.
Testing folder video files now show as portrait posters with a proper video poster, not landscape cards.
Actors & Directors folders show just the last name, bigger and centred, so it is easy to read and never cut off.

Downloads now show how much device storage is left: the progress bar shows free space while a file downloads, and the Downloads section has a storage row at the top (select it for the full breakdown).
Downloads section now ends its listing properly, like the other sections.

Non-Google provider files (Testing folder) no longer show as documents and no longer open to an empty list: playable files play in the app, and folder and page links open the provider page in the browser.
Testing folder items use a VIDEO tile instead of the DOCUMENT tile.
Bottom bar buttons no longer clip when a video is paused (RESUME and STOP now fit the bar).
Skip intro appears sooner, about 3 seconds in.
The update prompt no longer repeats after installing until you quit and relaunch.
Search keyboard now accepts Enter on Fire TV, including keyboards that only send a key-down or no action id.
To Be Catalogued now lists 01 - Testing first, with its own tile. SwissTransfer is registered as a provider.
Main collection folders sit closer together, like the other lists.
Actor and director subfolders show landscape art (a frame from the video) instead of a portrait poster.
Resume only shows on a video you have played before and are more than 30 seconds into.
About and Up to Date no longer appear on video details pages.
The year is gone from the top right of poster tiles.
Tile titles are smaller so the full title always shows, on poster and landscape tiles.
The Home button has a house icon.
The bottom news ticker no longer shows raw URLs.
Ratings on video details always name their source (IMDb, FanEdit.org or Movies Remastered) with the source badge next to them.
Video details titles always show in full, with no scrolling needed.
The FEFC and year labels are gone from the left bar on video details pages.
Fan edit changes are shown right on the video details page (from FanEdit.org and Drive notes) instead of pointing to a website.
Uncategorized no longer appears as a genre on video details pages.
Open in VLC and Open in Drive are back on video details pages (they were hidden behind the bottom bar).

Downloads: a Download button on video details with a top-right progress bar that stays visible on every page (hiding only while a video plays), a Downloads section in My List, and the Home My List tile counts downloads.
SKIP on the intro is a Home-style rectangle labelled SKIP. The intro video file is unchanged.
Video details buttons use the same Home tile shape, with the My List star kept.
Bottom bar labels are sized for the full words SEARCH, SOUND OFF, SETTINGS, ABOUT, HOME and Up To Date.
The Kodi Foundation notice is only in About.
Folder sound defaults on when the setting was never saved. An explicit off stays off.
Search asks for the Android keyboard first and says so if it has to use Kodi's keyboard.
Ticker text is capped so a long feed cannot blank the bar. A failed fetch keeps the previous line.
Attribute search requires black-and-white wording and recorded names to match. It does not guess a genre.
181 folder covers are listed in data/art-pending-181.json for a later clean-source pass. No generated art is applied.
Nine Facebook group URLs are recorded as unread. No group posts were added as edit notes.

Emmerich / Independence Day rotation adds two ASR-supported lines: We will not go quietly into the night, and We will not vanish without a fight. Die Hard coast and vault-music candidates were not added.
Provider Play buttons: only public files a documented check confirmed can play; a mislabeled What If record (actually an X-Men episode) is now a page link only.
Search results now say when they are a text match only and Optimus (Gemini) did not answer.
Kodi Testing tile shows the verified video count.
App feedback: contact email and a feedback form with a QR code (web Support Us, Kodi About > Give feedback).
Six AI cover edits applied as candidates (A Nightmare on Elm Street, All of Us Are Dead, Arrow, Ash vs Evil Dead, Battlestar Galactica, Black Sails); originals kept, 172 inputs still unprocessed.
Home ambience corrected to the Fire TV graph (intro tail + E-major pad, no extra +15.4 dB); intro.mp3 unchanged.
Kodi search dialog uses the Optimus watch image and cue.
Home ambience restored exactly as the old Fire TV app (soft pad + filtered loop), seamless, no thumping
Bottom menu bar: same width as the 3 menu columns, smaller font and fitted buttons so no label is cut off; compact 'Up To Date' box
Home mosaic: tiles exactly the size/spacing of the menu tiles - 5 down each side, 3 along the bottom; nothing behind the title; top bar no longer covers the corner tiles
News ticker: tighter spacing; X / Discord / Facebook / Reddit icons show again
Support Us: official Patreon, PayPal and Venmo logos on the Support Us tile and screen
About: added the 'FEFC is an unofficial community app built on Kodi' notice
No more 'Next Page': every list is one scrollable page (art loads lazily, light on Fire Stick)
Artwork: clean film stills replace 79 trailer-thumbnail folder covers; Batman: Hush and The Backrooms posters swapped for clean art

New movie sound clips (shuffled, no repeats): Die Hard, Happy Gilmore, Total Recall, Starship Troopers, Spy, Snatch, Tropic Thunder, Independence Day, Austin Powers (full Mustafa scene, Get in my belly)
Web app and Kodi now share version numbers (0.4.0)
Search results: video files now show as portrait posters; folders and docs stay landscape
Details page: 'Add to My List' button now carries the My List star icon
Details page File Info: length, file size, resolution, format and host, from read-only Drive metadata
Home: menu bar labels no longer cut off; 3x3 grid centred, black glossy tiles with the orange focus glow, long tile names wrap inside the tile
Home: mosaic video only around the grid, instant still-frame start, longer 75 s seamless loop (720p, low bitrate) bundled in the app
Home ambience is back (original FEFC recording), follows the Sound toggle, stops when you leave Home or play a file
Search and every FEFC text box use the Android / Fire TV system keyboard
Notifications: permission asked after the intro on Home (and again next launch until allowed); Settings now opens FEFC settings with the Notifications section, plus an 'Allow notifications' button
Actors & Directors: one A–Z list of everyone
Genres: new art for Musical, Drama, Horror, Family and War; names centred at the bottom; Unsorted merged into Uncategorized
Every page: same bottom menu bar as Home, no version in the corner; grids are 6 tiles wide
Shuffle Play / Sort / Support Us tiles show their name once
Phone/tablet: Android notifications when new files are added (same time as the daily social posts) — tap opens New Arrivals
Phone/tablet: Android notification when an app update is available (Update Available · v…) — tap opens the updater
Settings → Notifications: separate toggles for App update notifications and New files notifications (both default ON, remembered across updates)
Fire TV update popup is unchanged
News ticker (web + both Kodi packages): newly added collection files from the same daily feed as the social posts
New OnLive-style Home: centred 3x3 menu of dark glossy tiles with an orange glow on focus, over a looping wall of fan edit clips (silent)
Menu bar moved to a dark rounded bar at the bottom centre: Search, Sound, Settings, About and the update button
Clean, easier-to-read font throughout the app
Support Us opens tiles for Patreon, PayPal and Venmo with QR codes
Intro: a focused Skip Intro button appears after 3 seconds; one press of OK goes to Home
Updater always downloads the APK for the app that is actually installed (phones/tablets vs Fire TV)
Support Us shows Patreon, PayPal and Venmo icons above each QR code
Phone edge-swipe Back pops history the same way remote Back does
Folders, folder shortcuts, Shuffle Play, Sort and Support Us are landscape cards; video files stay portrait posters
Every file's details page plays a clip from its franchise folder (nearest parent folder with sounds)
Sound on/off button with a speaker icon in the top menu, remembered across restarts and updates
Search has a magnifying glass and Settings a gear icon
Home: Exit button, bottom-left logo, top-left version text and the word Community removed
Update button reads 'Up To Date · v…' or 'Update Available · v…'; pressing it always checks fresh and installs if newer
Details page restyled LCARS like the web app
Fan edit details: synopsis, editor, IFDB / Movies Remastered ratings and the full changes list
Drive shortcut folders now open as folders
Support Us and Read First docs shown inside folders
File titles now show the full name like the web app, including endings such as "- Fan Edit". Only the file extension is hidden.
Long titles have more room: collection tiles fit up to 4 lines and poster tiles up to 3, in a slightly smaller font. The full title of the focused item scrolls along the bottom bar.
Fixes the new FEFC app for phones and tablets (FEFC.apk) crashing on launch. Its app ID is now com.fefc.kodi, so reinstall it from the link. The Fire TV app is unchanged.

The new FEFC app for phones and tablets (FEFC.apk) now includes 64-bit Kodi, so it installs on 64-bit-only devices such as the Pixel Fold and Pixel Tablet. It also still runs on 32-bit devices. The Fire TV app is unchanged.
New installs can use a separate FEFC app (com.faneditfanclub.fefc.kodi) that installs alongside regular Kodi from the Play Store.
Existing FEFC installs keep updating as before, and each one downloads the update that matches it.
Fire Stick home: the FEFC app tile now uses a plain FEFC icon like the original FEFC Fire TV app, instead of the adaptive icon that Fire Sticks showed as a grey grid.

Updates: after What's New, pressing Install closes every popup and downloads in one go with a progress bar. No other update popup can open on top, a dropped connection resumes and retries by itself, and the file is checked before Android's installer opens.

Fire TV home: the FEFC banner tile now uses the same banner setup as the original FEFC Fire TV app (320x180 banner in the default and xhdpi folders), so older Fire Sticks show FEFC art instead of a grey placeholder.
The FEFC icon and banner on the Fire TV home and apps row are fixed: each update now has its own Android version number, so Fire TV refreshes the app tile instead of showing it blank.
Home tile counts now match the web app: Main Collection no longer double-counts files from shortcuts and To Be Catalogued, and Fan Edit Collections now counts its shortcut collections.
The FEFC app icon is back next to the version and update button on the Home screen.
Home tiles show counts like the web app: collections and files on Main Collection, Fan Edit Collections and To Be Catalogued; collections on Actors & Directors; genres on Genres.
The My List tile has a star and shows how many items you've starred. Counts update every minute.
My List: the sync popup only opens when you select Link My List or Sync, and it no longer pops up again after you close it and go back Home.
When My List isn't linked, its first item reads Link My List.
The update popup now waits until the Home screen is showing after the intro.

The top bar (version, Search, Settings, About, clock) and the community news ticker with its icons now show on every page: home, lists, details, Read Me and settings. Press Up to reach the bar. Both hide while a video plays full screen.
Link My List: the QR code now loads from the web on a white background, and the full link shows underneath so you can type it on your phone if you need to.

Link My List: the QR code is now a standard full-colour image on a white background, so it shows on Fire TV instead of a black square. If it can't be made on the device, it loads from the web instead.
News ticker: each post now has its Discord, Facebook, X or Reddit icon right before it as it scrolls, like the web app. The grouped icons by COMMUNITY are gone.
Link My List: the QR code now shows (it was a blank square on Fire TV).
Link My List: the link address is shortened so it fits on screen.
The community news ticker shows the Discord, Facebook, X and Reddit icons, like the web app ticker.

Home screen is back to the 3x3 grid in the same order as the web app: Read Me, New Arrivals, Support Us / Fan Edit Collections, Main Collection, To Be Catalogued / Actors & Directors, My List, Genres.
Search, Settings and About moved to a top bar, like the web app header.
Read Me: link addresses are no longer spelled out, and the file count now says 6,000.
Selecting a movie or episode now opens its details page first; Play is a button there.
Search: pressing Enter opens the results directly and the keyboard no longer pops up over them.
My List sync entry is now a proper menu action.
The intro now plays first, with no flash of the menu.
New home screen: Read Me, New Arrivals, Support Us, My List, Collections, Main Collection, To Be Catalogued, Genres, Actors & Directors, Search, Settings and About.
Main Collection opens the top level of the whole collection, like the web app.
Continue Watching and Recently Opened, synced with your My List and the web app.
Sort any collection (A-Z, Z-A, Recently Added, Most Files) and Shuffle Play a collection or genre.
My List sorting, plus ratings and file size on the details page.
Landscape tiles for collections, poster tiles for edits, safe-area margins and a scrolling community news ticker.
Back while a video plays pauses it and keeps your place; RESUME or STOP from the menu.
Open in VLC and Open in Drive from the details page; FEFC navigation sounds.
The update screen shows this what's-new list; the home Update tile always shows your version and flags a new one. A check runs after the intro.
